result: std_smoke.rs runs a Rust std program (threads, TLS, caught panic, fork-then-exec child, re-exec, file and env I/O, exit status) as a libniji process in the native pass; README and toolchain.md section 8 now say host-built std programs run under libniji and where libgcc_s.so.1 comes from
informational: The test cannot see whether std took its fork path: gid() forces it today (strace: clone with SIGCHLD only, then execve); a std change back to posix_spawn would go unnoticed
Shown with the native pass's prefixed loader only, not with libniji installed as the system C library
cargo xtask plants printed 'caught by no test the log names' for every plant of an `affected --only` command although the msg regex matched

impact.what: tests added (std_smoke, runs in pass 1 and the native pass)
README and docs/toolchain.md section 8 no longer say Rust std programs are unsupported; they state what runs, what is untried, and the libgcc_s.so.1 dependency

improvement: cargo xtask plants could name the test from nextest's FAIL line in an `affected --only` log instead of printing 'caught by no test the log names'
